strings.Na CPU o Clef usa a memória RAM e não di: On the CPU the Clef uses system RAM and does not compete with the Qwen for the graphics card: that is the default and nothing has to be unloaded between images. It costs RAM (about 18 GB in bf16; about 9.5 GB quantized to int8; about 5.6 GB with int4) and answers in 1 to 3 seconds. On the GPU it is much faster, but it takes the Qwen's VRAM and usually has to be unloaded before every generation. What the Clef server reports in /health wins: this setting applies when it reports nothing, and it also decides whether PickFlow frees the ComfyUI VRAM before the Clef decides. To actually switch, click Apply on the server to change it without restarting; if your server is older, start it with --device cpu (or --device cuda) and, if RAM is tight, with --quant int8 or int4.

strings.Workflow oficial do ComfyUI (Qwen-Image: Official ComfyUI workflow (Qwen-Image 2.1, Image Edit) with the remove-background prompt. The comparison node (472) isn't used by PickFlow.
strings.Usa nós do pacote ComfyUI-RMBG (RMBG e S: Uses nodes from the ComfyUI-RMBG pack (RMBG and SAM3Segment; SAM3 downloads the sam3.pt model by itself the first time). After the cutout, PickFlow trims the transparent borders, so the size you adjust in the chat is the person's own.
strings.Recortar uma PESSOA (ou mais de uma) da: Cut out a PERSON (or more than one) from the photo. It's the default: use it when the request talks about a person, woman, man, model, she, he.
strings.Recortar um OBJETO, móvel, animal ou coi: Cut out an OBJECT, furniture, animal or thing by NAME (SAM3 finds the thing the request mentioned, even with others around).
strings.A imagem é só o objeto num fundo liso (f: The image is just the object on a plain background (product photo): removes the whole background with RMBG.
strings.Rápido, 6 passos. É o padrão: use sempre: Fast, 6 steps. It's the default: use it whenever the user doesn't ask for more quality.
strings.Mais lento e detalhado, 25 passos. Só qu: Slower and more detailed, 25 steps. Only when the user asks for top quality, more detail or says there's no rush.
strings.Usa o grafo de edição sem imagens, ligan: Uses the editing graph without images, turning on 'Custom output size'. The size comes from the 'Output size' node (ResolutionSelector).
strings.Workflow oficial do ComfyUI (Qwen-Image: Official ComfyUI workflow (Qwen-Image 2.1, text to image, 25 steps). The built-in prompt rewriter (nodes 471, 473 and 475) is dropped so the extra text model isn't needed; PickFlow already writes the prompt. The size comes from the ResolutionSelector node saved in the workflow.

strings.Apache-2.0 (o modelo base é Qwen Researc: Apache-2.0 (the base model is Qwen Research, non-commercial use)

strings.Converte o resultado do TripoSplat em sp: Turns TripoSplat's result into a splat.

strings.Usar o render com o cinza: Use the render with the gray
strings.Gire a câmera até o ângulo que você quer: Turn the camera to the angle you want. "Fill in the gray (Outpaint)" sends the render of this angle to Edit with the Outpaint LoRA, which fills the gray (what the photo didn't show) by continuing the scene; "Use the render with the gray" gives you the render as it is.

strings.Arraste os pontos de quem você quer muda: Drag the points of whoever you want to change pose.
strings.Cada pessoa da foto aparece como um esqu: Each person in the photo appears as a skeleton. Drag the points to build the new pose: the whole limb follows. Whoever you don't touch stays as they are.
strings.Vira a pose desta pessoa para o outro la: Flips this person's pose to the other side
strings.Acrescenta os pontos que o detector não: Adds the points the detector didn't see (cut off by the edge of the photo)
strings.Alt + arrastar mexe só no ponto. Shift +: Alt + drag moves only the point. Shift + drag stretches the bone. Dragging the neck moves the whole person.

strings.Apagando o lugar antigo dos membros que: Erasing the old place of the limbs that moved…
strings.Mantendo os pixels da foto original fora: Keeping the original photo's pixels everywhere except the limbs that moved.
strings.Ligue o servidor do Clef: abra clef_serv: Start the Clef server: open clef_server/start_clef.bat (the first time it installs everything by itself) or, just to try the interface, switch to test mode in Settings.
strings.A foto com a pessoa que será trocada: de: The photo with the person to be replaced: the pose, light, framing and background come from it.
strings.A pessoa que deve aparecer no lugar (cor: The person who must appear instead (body and head, or only the head).
strings.A foto da pessoa que vai vestir a roupa: The photo of the person who will wear the clothing (face, hair, hands, pose and background stay the same).
strings.A foto com a roupa a vestir (pode ser a: The photo with the clothing to wear (it can be another person's outfit).
strings.Usado pelos fluxos de trocar pessoa e tr: Used by the person swap and clothing swap flows (AusBoss). In the clothing swap it also describes the clothing in the reference photo.
strings.Modelo que gera as imagens. Só aparecem: Model that generates the images. Only the ones that have a workflow in PickFlow and are installed in ComfyUI are listed.
strings.Trocar a pessoa, manter a roupa da cena: Swap the person, keep the scene clothing and take her to another place
strings.Automático: cada workflow usa o seu: Automatic: each workflow uses its own
strings.O Qwen3-VL 8B em duas versões. Os workfl: Qwen3-VL 8B in two versions. The edit, transfer, pose and 3D workflows use fp8 (heretic); the swap person and swap clothing ones use int8 (convrot). Picking a version swaps the file in every workflow; you can only pick the ones ComfyUI has.
strings.não usado (outro codificador escolhido e: not used (another encoder chosen in Settings)
strings.Ajuda quando o ComfyUI e o Clef dividem: Helps when ComfyUI and the Clef share the same graphics card.
strings.O assistente confere o que os workflows: The assistant checks what the workflows need inside ComfyUI (PickFlow nodes, LoRAs, models) and installs what you tick. The check converts each workflow to the ComfyUI API and verifies nodes, links and models; run it after changing workflows.
strings.Onde o servidor do Clef está. Para ligar: Where the Clef server is. To start the one that ships with PickFlow, run start_clef (it asks bf16 or int4).
strings.Ele pode levar uns 30 s só para carregar: It can take about 30 s just to load the model on the first request.
strings.Clef e ComfyUI na mesma máquina: o PickF: Clef and ComfyUI on the same machine: PickFlow measures the memory and unloads the Clef before generating only when the two do not fit together.
strings.Na CPU o Clef usa a RAM (~18 GB em bf16): On the CPU the Clef uses RAM (~18 GB in bf16) and does not compete with the Qwen for the card. On the GPU it is much faster, but it takes VRAM and usually gets unloaded before each generation; int4 (~7.9 GB) only runs on an NVIDIA card. The server reports what it is using in /health: this setting applies when it reports nothing. "Apply on the server" switches without restarting.
strings.Ligue o servidor do Clef: dê dois clique: Start the Clef server: double-click clef_server/start_clef.bat (Windows) or run bash clef_server/start_clef.sh (Linux/macOS); the first time it installs everything by itself and asks bf16 or int4. Just to see the interface working, use test mode.
strings.Modo de teste ligado. Para decisões de v: Test mode is on. For real decisions, start the Clef and switch in Settings > Clef.
